name: home-new-tools
assert: (() => { const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.home-card')].map(a=>a.textContent); const need=['图片取色 / 颜色转换','房贷与利息计算器','文本工具箱','PDF 加页码','时间戳转换器']; const missing=need.filter(n=>!cards.some(c=>c.includes(n))); return {pass: missing.length===0, detail: 'cards='+cards.length+' missing='+missing.join(',')}; })()

name: text-dedupe

steps.eval: (() => { const ta=document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label="待处理文本"]'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(ta,'苹果\n香蕉\n苹果'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()
(() => { const lab=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.includes('去重行（保留首次）')); if(!lab) return 'no-label'; lab.click(); return true; })()

assert: (() => { const out=document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label="处理结果"]'); if(!out) return {pass:false,detail:'no output'}; const lines=out.value.split('\n').filter(Boolean); return {pass: lines.length===2 && lines[0]==='苹果' && lines[1]==='香蕉', detail: JSON.stringify(out.value)}; })()

name: timestamp-epoch

steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="时间戳输入"]'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,'0'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; return {pass: t.includes('1970') && t.includes('08:00'), detail: t.slice(0,120)}; })()

name: finance-mortgage-default
assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; const ok=/(5,?307\.27)/.test(t) || /(910,?61[0-9])/.test(t); return {pass: ok, detail: t.slice(0,150)}; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const set=(labelText,v)=>{const lab=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.includes(labelText)); if(!lab) throw new Error('no label '+labelText); const el=lab.querySelector('input'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(el,v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; set('年龄（',30); set('身高（cm）',175); set('体重（kg）',70); return true; })()

name: developer-md5

steps.eval: (() => { const sel=document.querySelector('select'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(sel,'md5'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

(() => { const ta=document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label="待处理文本"]'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(ta,'abc'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

assert: (() => { const out=document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label="处理结果"]'); const v=out?out.value:''; return {pass: v==='900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72', detail: v.slice(0,200)}; })()

name: color-picker-upload

steps.eval: (() => { const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas'); if(!canvas) return 'no-canvas'; const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x=r.left+r.width*0.25, y=r.top+r.height*0.5; const opts={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,pointerId:1,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:true}; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',opts)); canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',opts)); return 'clicked'; })()

assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; const canvas=!!document.querySelector('canvas'); return {pass: canvas && t.includes('主色板') && /#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}/.test(t), detail: t.slice(0,150)}; })()

name: stitch-two-images
assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; return {pass: t.includes('拼接完成') || t.includes('预计输出'), detail: t.slice(-160)}; })()

name: pdf-page-number
assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; return {pass: t.includes('下载新PDF') || t.includes('已生成'), detail: t.slice(-180)}; })()

name: pdf-crop

steps.eval: (() => { const set=(labelText,v)=>{const lab=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.includes(labelText)); if(!lab) throw new Error('no label '+labelText); const el=lab.querySelector('input'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(el,v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; set('上边距（mm）',10); set('下边距（mm）',10); set('左边距（mm）',10); set('右边距（mm）',10); return true; })()

assert: (() => { const t=document.body.innerText; return {pass: t.includes('下载裁剪后的PDF') || t.includes('已生成'), detail: t.slice(-180)}; })()
